description: Create an evidence tracking record from a catalog evidence ID (write — editor+ role). Starts tracking an evidence item for the organization.

collecting_system.description: Name of the tool or system that collects the evidence

evidence_id.description: Catalog evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01') — obtain from scf_list_evidence_catalog

is_tracked.description: Start actively tracking this item (default false)

maturity_level.description: Evidence maturity level L0–L5 (e.g., 'L3'); omit to leave unset

owner.description: Person accountable for this evidence item

system_id.description: System UUID to link this evidence to — obtain from scf_list_systems

name: scf_create_evidence
